Script.name: mapimport
Script.script:
--[[ Map Import — MUSHclient mapper database -> Mudlet map Sean Stoves, 2026-07-31
Reads src/data/mapdata.txt (produced by src/tools/export_map.py) and builds the Mudlet map from it: 22,931 rooms, ~73k exits, 1.6k special exits.
Chunked through tempTimer rather than one straight loop — building the lot synchronously locks the client up for the best part of a minute and looks like a hang.
aardmap check - what's in the file vs what's in the map now aardmap import - wipe the current map and build from the file aardmap save - write the map to disk ]]
solao = solao or {} solao.mapimport = solao.mapimport or {}
local MI = solao.mapimport local U = solao.util
local DATA = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/src/data/mapdata.txt"
local CFG = U.load("mapimport", {})
-- Small chunks with a real yield between them. The first run at 1500/4000 with -- a 0.05s yield took Mudlet down: every addRoom re-renders the map if the mapper -- widget is open, so the work per chunk was far larger than the call count -- suggests. Yielding more often keeps the UI alive and lets the GC breathe. local ROOM_CHUNK = 500 local EXIT_CHUNK = 1500 local YIELD = 0.1
-- Mudlet wants the long names; the mapper stored single letters local DIRNAME = { n = "north", s = "south", e = "east", w = "west", u = "up", d = "down" }
-- the mapper's env colours are palette indices, not RGB local PALETTE = { [0] = { 0, 0, 0 }, [1] = { 128, 0, 0 }, [2] = { 0, 128, 0 }, [3] = { 128, 128, 0 }, [4] = { 0, 0, 128 }, [5] = { 128, 0, 128 }, [6] = { 0, 128, 128 }, [7] = { 192, 192, 192 }, [8] = { 128, 128, 128 }, [9] = { 255, 0, 0 }, [10] = { 0, 255, 0 }, [11] = { 255, 255, 0 }, [12] = { 0, 0, 255 }, [13] = { 255, 0, 255 }, [14] = { 0, 255, 255 }, [15] = { 255, 255, 255 }, }
-- Counts only — used by 'check'. Deliberately does not retain the lines. local function scan() local fh = io.open(DATA, "r") if not fh then return nil end local n = { A = 0, E = 0, R = 0, X = 0, S = 0 } for line in fh:lines() do local k = line:sub(1, 1) if n[k] then n[k] = n[k] + 1 end end fh:close() return n end
local function split(line) local p = {} for f in (line .. "\t"):gmatch("(.-)\t") do p[#p + 1] = f end return p end
--- -- check ---
function MI.check() local n = scan() if not n then U.err("Map Import: can't read " .. DATA) U.note("Run: python3 " .. getMudletHomeDir() .. "/src/tools/export_map.py") return end
local have = 0 for _ in pairs(getRooms() or {}) do have = have + 1 end
U.help("Map Import", { { "file", DATA }, { "areas", tostring(n.A) }, { "environments", tostring(n.E) }, { "rooms", tostring(n.R) }, { "exits", tostring(n.X) }, { "special exits", tostring(n.S) }, { "" }, { "map now", have .. " rooms" }, { "" }, { "'aardmap import' replaces the current map with this one." }, }) end
--- -- import ---
local job
local function finish() local parts = { job.rooms .. " rooms" } if job.present > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = job.present .. " already present" end parts[#parts + 1] = job.exits .. " exits" parts[#parts + 1] = job.specials .. " special exits" if job.skipped > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = job.skipped .. " UNUSABLE" end U.ok("Map Import: done - " .. table.concat(parts, ", ") .. ".") if job.skipped > 0 then U.warn("Map Import: " .. job.skipped .. " row(s) had no id or no known area.") end U.note("Map Import: run 'aardmap save' to write it to disk, then restart Mudlet.") U.note("The mapper reopens from the toolbar's Map button (or 'lua openMapWidget()').") job = nil centerview(getPlayerRoom() or 1) end
local function step() if not job then return end
local budget = job.phase == "rooms" and ROOM_CHUNK or EXIT_CHUNK local done = 0
while done < budget do local line = job.fh:read("*l")
if not line then job.fh:close() if job.phase == "rooms" then U.note("Map Import: " .. job.rooms .. " rooms placed, linking exits...") job.phase = "exits" job.fh = io.open(DATA, "r") if not job.fh then U.err("Map Import: lost the data file partway through.") job = nil return end break else finish() return end end
local k = line:sub(1, 1)
if k == "R" and job.phase == "rooms" then local p = split(line) local id = tonumber(p[2]) local area = job.areas[p[3]] if id and area and job.resume and roomExists(id) then -- already built by an earlier run; nothing to do, and it is NOT -- a skip - counting it as one made a clean resume read as a -- total failure job.present = job.present + 1 elseif id and area then addRoom(id) setRoomArea(id, area) setRoomCoordinates(id, tonumber(p[4]) or 0, tonumber(p[5]) or 0, tonumber(p[6]) or 0) if p[8] and p[8] ~= "" then setRoomName(id, p[8]) end local env = tonumber(p[7]) if env and env > 0 then setRoomEnv(id, env) end -- terrain is deliberately NOT stored as user data: setRoomEnv -- already carries it, and it was 22,927 redundant writes if p[10] and p[10] ~= "" then setRoomUserData(id, "info", p[10]) end if p[11] and p[11] ~= "" then setRoomUserData(id, "notes", p[11]) end job.rooms = job.rooms + 1 else job.skipped = job.skipped + 1 end done = done + 1
elseif k == "X" and job.phase == "exits" then local p = split(line) local f, t = tonumber(p[2]), tonumber(p[3]) local d = DIRNAME[p[4]] if f and t and d and roomExists(f) and roomExists(t) then setExit(f, t, d) job.exits = job.exits + 1 else job.skipped = job.skipped + 1 end done = done + 1
elseif k == "S" and job.phase == "exits" then local p = split(line) local f, t = tonumber(p[2]), tonumber(p[3]) if f and t and p[4] and p[4] ~= "" and roomExists(f) and roomExists(t) then addSpecialExit(f, t, p[4]) job.specials = job.specials + 1 else job.skipped = job.skipped + 1 end done = done + 1 end end
if job then local n = job.phase == "rooms" and job.rooms or (job.exits + job.specials) if n - (job.reported or 0) >= 8000 then job.reported = n U.note("Map Import: " .. n .. " " .. job.phase .. "...") end collectgarbage("step") tempTimer(YIELD, step) end end
function MI.import(confirmed, resume) if job then U.warn("Map Import: already running.") return end if not (confirmed or resume) then U.warn("This REPLACES the current Mudlet map. Confirm with: aardmap import yes") return end
local fh = io.open(DATA, "r") if not fh then U.err("Map Import: can't read " .. DATA) return end
-- Shut the mapper first. It re-renders on every room added, which is what -- turned 22,931 addRoom calls into a client-killer on the first attempt. -- Best-effort: it throws if the widget wasn't open, which is fine. if U.has("closeMapWidget") and pcall(closeMapWidget) then U.note("Map Import: closed the mapper window for the duration.") end
if resume then U.note("Map Import: resuming - keeping the rooms already built.") else U.note("Map Import: clearing the current map...") deleteMap() end
-- areas and environments first; rooms reference both. Streamed and -- discarded as we go rather than held - the whole file as a Lua table was -- tens of MB sitting alongside Mudlet's own map structures. local areas, envs = {}, 0 for line in fh:lines() do local k = line:sub(1, 1) if k == "A" then local p = split(line) local id = addAreaName(p[3] ~= "" and p[3] or p[2]) if id then areas[p[2]] = id end elseif k == "E" then local p = split(line) local id, colour = tonumber(p[2]), tonumber(p[4]) local rgb = PALETTE[colour or 7] or PALETTE[7] if id then setCustomEnvColor(id, rgb[1], rgb[2], rgb[3], 255) envs = envs + 1 end end end fh:close() U.note("Map Import: " .. envs .. " environments, building rooms...")
job = { fh = io.open(DATA, "r"), areas = areas, phase = "rooms", reported = 0, resume = resume, rooms = 0, exits = 0, specials = 0, skipped = 0, present = 0, } if not job.fh then U.err("Map Import: can't reopen the data file.") job = nil return end step() end
--- -- commands ---
function MI.cmd(arg) local verb, rest = U.split_verb(arg)
if verb == "" or verb == "check" then MI.check()
elseif verb == "import" then MI.import(U.trim(rest):lower() == "yes", false)
elseif verb == "resume" then MI.import(false, true)
elseif verb == "stop" then if job then if job.fh then job.fh:close() end U.warn(string.format("Map Import: stopped after %d rooms, %d exits. The map is" .. " half-built - re-run 'aardmap import yes' or don't save it.", job.rooms, job.exits + job.specials)) job = nil else U.note("Map Import: nothing running.") end
elseif verb == "zoom" then local arg2 = U.trim(rest) if arg2:lower() == "off" then CFG.zoom = nil U.save("mapimport", CFG) U.ok("Map zoom: no longer overriding the module's default.") else local n = tonumber(arg2) if n then MI.setzoom(n) CFG.zoom = n U.save("mapimport", CFG) U.ok("Map zoom " .. n .. ", and it'll be reapplied after each login.") else local ok, cur = pcall(getMapZoom) U.help("Map zoom", { { "current", ok and tostring(cur) or "unknown" }, { "preferred", CFG.zoom and tostring(CFG.zoom) or "(none - module's 35 stands)" }, { "" }, { "aardmap zoom <n>", "set it, and keep it across logins" }, { "aardmap zoom off", "stop overriding" }, { "" }, { "The module calls setMapZoom(35) shortly after load, which" }, { "is why a zoom you set by hand doesn't survive a relogin." }, { "Setting it here reapplies yours a few seconds later." }, }) end end
elseif verb == "save" then if saveMap() then U.ok("Map Import: map saved.") else U.err("Map Import: saveMap() failed.") end
else U.help("aardmap", { { "aardmap check", "what's in the export vs the live map" }, { "aardmap import yes", "replace the map with the MUSHclient one" }, { "aardmap resume", "carry on without wiping what's already built" }, { "aardmap save", "write the map to disk" }, { "aardmap stop", "abort a running import" }, { "aardmap zoom [n]", "read or set the mapper zoom" }, { "" }, { "Regenerate the export with:" }, { " python3 " .. getMudletHomeDir() .. "/src/tools/export_map.py" }, }) end end
-- Geyser.Mapper embeds into the main window, so the bare call is the right -- target for the module's panel; the named form is for Mudlet's separate dock. function MI.setzoom(n) local done = pcall(setMapZoom, n) pcall(setMapZoom, n, "mapwin") return done end
-- The module sets 35 on a short timer after load. Land after it, not before. function MI.on_connect() if CFG.zoom then tempTimer(4, function() MI.setzoom(CFG.zoom) end) end end
U.killhandler(solao_map_zoom_handler) solao_map_zoom_handler = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysConnectionEvent", "solao.mapimport.on_connect")
solao.register("aardmap", "MUSHclient mapper -> Mudlet map import", MI.cmd)
